intro: Enjoy a deliciously smooth blend of roasted peanuts and creamy mango flavor with Peanut Butter Mango Cream. This unique spread combines nutrition and taste, giving you a fruity twist on classic peanut butter that’s perfect for everyday enjoyment.

li: Premium Roasted Peanuts for rich, nutty taste
Creamy Mango Flavor for a refreshing tropical touch
High in Protein to support energy and active lifestyles
Gluten Free – suitable for daily consumption
No Trans Fat – clean and balanced nutrition

p: Spread it on toast, chapati, or bread, blend it into smoothies, add to oatmeal, or enjoy it straight from the spoon.
A tasty, wholesome, and innovative peanut butter that makes every bite smooth, fruity, and satisfying.
